# BlockEntityStorageInfo Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

Contains identifying information about an entity stored in a [*@minecraft/server.BlockEntityStorageComponent*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/BlockEntityStorageComponent.md). Stored entities are not present in the world until they are released.

## Properties

### **definitionId**
`read-only definitionId: string;`

The entity's definition ID, such as `minecraft:pig`.

Type: *string*

### **uniqueId**
`read-only uniqueId: string;`

The unique ID of the stored entity. Use this ID with [*@minecraft/server.BlockEntityStorageComponent.release*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/BlockEntityStorageComponent.md#release) or [*@minecraft/server.BlockEntityStorageComponent.transfer*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/BlockEntityStorageComponent.md#transfer).

Type: *string*
